Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. content.text: The output file shows the agent transcript in JSONL format. Let me directly search the internal/ directory to find exported functions and analyze their fan-in counts.

input.description: List Go files in internal/ directory

content.text: Now let me find which exported function has the most inbound calls by checking how many times each is referenced:

input.command:
# Get all exported functions from internal/
grep -r "^func [A-Z]" /bench/repo/internal --include="*.go" | grep -v "_test.go" | sed 's/:.*func /:/g' | sort -u > /tmp/internal_funcs.txt

# For each function, count how many times it's called in the whole codebase (excluding tests and its own file)
while IFS=: read file func; do
  func_name=$(echo "$func" | awk '{print $1}')
  # Count calls to this function across the codebase (but exclude test files and the file where it's defined)
  count=$(grep -r "$func_name" /bench/repo --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" | grep -v "^$file:" | grep -v "^Binary" | wc -l)
  echo "$count|$func_name|$file"
done < /tmp/internal_funcs.txt | sort -rn | head -20
input.description: Count fan-in for each exported function

content.text: Let me refine this to get more accurate counts by being more precise with the function signatures:

input.command:
# Extract exported functions more carefully
grep -rh "^func [A-Z]" /bench/repo/internal --include="*.go" | grep -v "_test.go" | while read line; do
  # Extract just the function name (before the opening paren)
  func_name=$(echo "$line" | sed 's/^func //' | sed 's/(.*//')
  file=$(grep -r "func $func_name" /bench/repo/internal --include="*.go" | grep -v "_test.go" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  
  # Count occurrences in codebase (excluding test files and the definition file, using word boundaries)
  count=$(grep -rw "$func_name" /bench/repo --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" | grep -v "^$file:" | grep -v "^Binary" | wc -l)
  
  if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "$count|$func_name|$file"
